findings.title: Every <Cite> link points at <base>sources#key without the trailing slash, so GitHub Pages and plain file servers answer it with a 301; astro preview answers 200, so no gate check sees it

notes: Environment, for the orchestrator. Astro's CLI (node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs) calls module.enableCompileCache() unless CI is set. Every agent's build on this machine writes into the one directory /tmp/node-compile-cache/v22.22.0-x64-*/ (strace showed one rename there per module). With about ten builds running at once, every astro build sat in do_renameat2/open_last_lookups for 20 minutes or more; mine used 1 minute of CPU in 20 minutes. With NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 the same build took about 2 minutes. Exporting that variable (or CI=1) for build agents would remove most of the stalls. It does not affect CI on GitHub or a single build on the owner's machine, so it is not a repository finding.
